name: _cufft_get_plan_cache_size
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI), copied verbatim from the supplied registered schema: aten::_cufft_get_plan_cache_size(int device_index) -> int. This representative signature is not exclusive: the original Gems pytest owns the full contract and defines the overloads, keyword arguments, returns, errors, aliasing and mutation behavior it exercises, so tests must never be narrowed or removed and reference behavior must not be adapted to fit this one signature. Other registered schema strings supplied for this operator, verbatim: aten::_cufft_get_plan_cache_size(int device_index) -> int. Semantics: reports how many plans the process-wide cuFFT plan cache currently holds for one device, identified by device_index; it consumes no tensor, returns a plain Python int, and has no mutation, aliasing or tensor-shape behavior. The native bounds check reads only the low byte of device_index, so indices that alias an existing device through their low byte resolve to that aliased device (for example 256 and 1024 on a one-device host, and negatives whose low byte is 0 such as -(2**31) and -(2**63)), while indices whose low byte names no present device are rejected; -1 has low byte 0xff and is therefore rejected on a one-device host. Wrong-typed arguments, a missing device index, and extra positional arguments are also rejected by pytest. Overload-dependent, aliasing and error behavior remains defined by the original Gems pytest, not by this single signature model.
